> 第二十二章 中级学徒（第1页）
提起解毒剂，除了梅丽掏出的那支低级解毒剂之外，塞恩立马还想起自己手里还有半瓶摩西多大师赐予的中级解毒剂。
不过那支解毒剂被塞恩放在了他和莉娜的家，现在需要尽快取来服用。
“我们先回去了，大家过段时间再见！”塞恩搀扶着莉娜的手臂，对面前的鲍斯和梅丽说道。
塞恩好歹还有鲍斯和梅丽这两个交心朋友，包括与他相熟，但是关系一般的低级学徒也有好几个。
但莉娜却从始至终都是孤家寡人一个，除了塞恩之外，她在黑魔法学院似乎没有任何可以交谈的人。
“嗯，有事就来东城区找我，你知道我在哪家商店的。”胖子鲍斯先回答道。
这胖子也对高级学徒实力并且素来冰冷的莉娜极为忌惮，不过他的表现至少比梅丽好多了，并没有暴露出明显怯意。
一边偷偷看了眼莉娜，一边迅速将自己红布包里的三支药剂，塞到塞恩手里。
这三支药剂同样都是梅丽自己做的低级恢复性药剂。
涉及精神力和魔力恢复的药剂都太高端，梅丽暂时还做不出来。
这三支低级恢复药剂，仅仅是能帮助愈合一些外伤，加快肌体组织恢复罢了。
但这也属实不易，别忘了梅丽今年才多少岁，她又跟着迪尔思大师才学习了多久的药剂学。
在魔索布拉城，药剂的价值，并不逊色于魔法道具多少。
哪怕是最低级别的药剂，也不是一般魔法学徒能消费的。
不然塞恩当初也不会光着膀子就去找咸水巨鳄的麻烦。
看了眼手中的三支药剂，塞恩向梅丽投去一个感谢的眼神。
只是莉娜的情况拖不得，也顾不上再交谈些什么，塞恩搀扶着莉娜径直向宿舍楼走去。
一直目送塞恩和莉娜离开训练场，胖子鲍斯和梅丽才准备动身离开。

只不过在离开前，胖子鲍斯搓了搓自己的肥手，笑嘻嘻的对梅丽说道：“梅丽小妹妹，挺厉害的嘛，竟然能制作低级解毒剂和低级恢复药剂了。”
“要不你照顾照顾我的生意，赚到了钱，我们三七分。”鲍斯对梅丽说道。
，他们是凭借塞恩作为中介，才互相认识的。
鲍斯以前还觉得，塞恩凭白照顾这小丫头是同情心泛滥。
现在来看，是人家早有眼光，反倒是他自己有些短视了。
面对胖子鲍斯的讨好笑容，小丫头梅丽则翻了翻白眼。
刚来幽暗地域时，这的确是个纯洁无瑕的小女孩，但在魔索布拉城的黑魔法学院学习生活了这么久，再纯洁的小白花，必然也适应了一部分地底世界的环境氛围。
只见梅丽并没有立即被鲍斯的讨好笑容所打动，而是摇了摇头说道：“我制作低级恢复药剂的成功率只有三成，低级解毒剂的成功率只有一成。”
“如果你能提供给我制作药剂的相应材料，我可以考虑跟你合作。”
梅丽的讨价还价，证明了她在黑魔法学院也渐渐变得成熟。
面对梅丽提出的合作条件，胖子鲍斯先是面色一苦。
不过紧接着从梅丽口中得知她大概需要哪些药剂原材料后，胖子的神色又明显舒缓了一些。
“你说的这些材料都很低端，用不了几个黑金，但是想必你用的量会很大。”
“所以具体的药剂售后分成，我们得再谈谈。”胖子鲍斯说道。

> Chapter 22 Intermediate Apprentice (Page 1)
Speaking of antidotes, in addition to the low-level antidote that Meili took out, Thane immediately remembered that he also had half a bottle of the intermediate antidote given by Master Mosido in his hand.
However, Thain had placed the antidote at his and Lina's home, and now it needed to be taken as soon as possible.
"We're going back first. See you all soon!" Thain supported Lina's arm and said to Boss and Meili in front of him.
After all, Thain still has two close friends, Baos and Meili, including several low-level apprentices who are familiar with him but have only average relationships with him.
But Lina was always alone. Apart from Thane, she didn't seem to have anyone she could talk to at the Black Magic Academy.
"Well, if you need anything, come to me in Dongcheng District. You know which store I'm in." Fatty Boss replied first.
The fat man was also extremely wary of Lina, who was a senior apprentice and always cold. However, his performance was at least much better than that of Meili, and he did not show any obvious cowardice.
While secretly glancing at Lina, he quickly stuffed the three potions in his red cloth bag into Thane's hand.
These three potions are also low-level restorative potions made by Meili herself.
The potions involved in restoring mental power and magic power are too high-end, and Meili can't make them yet.
These three low-level recovery potions can only help heal some trauma and speed up the recovery of body tissues.
But it is not easy. Don't forget how old Meili is and how long she has been studying pharmacy with Master Diers.
In the city of Mensobra, the value of potions is not inferior to that of magic props.
Even the lowest level of potion is not something that ordinary magic apprentices can consume.
Otherwise, Thain wouldn't have gone shirtless to trouble the giant saltwater crocodile.
After looking at the three potions in his hand, Thane cast a grateful look at Meili.
But Lina's situation couldn't be delayed, and she didn't care to talk anymore. Thain helped Lina and walked straight to the dormitory building.
After watching Thain and Lina leave the training ground, Fatty Boss and Meili prepared to leave.
But before leaving, Fatty Boss rubbed his fat hands and said to Meili with a smile: "Little sister Meili, you are quite amazing. You can actually make low-level antidote and low-level recovery potion."
"How about you take care of my business and make money, and we'll split it 30-70," Bose said to Meili.
, they got to know each other through Thain as an intermediary.
Bose used to think that Thain's compassion for taking care of this little girl for nothing was overflowing.
Looking at it now, it seems that others have been foresighted for a long time, but he himself is a bit short-sighted.
Faced with Fatty Bose's flattering smile, the little girl Meili rolled her eyes.
When she first came to the Underdark Region, she was indeed a pure and flawless little girl, but after studying and living at the Black Magic Academy in Mensobra City for so long, no matter how pure the little white flower was, she must have adapted to some of the environment and atmosphere of the underground world.
Meili was not immediately moved by Bose's flattering smile. Instead, she shook her head and said, "My success rate in making low-level recovery potions is only 30%, and my success rate in making low-level antidote is only 10%."
"If you can provide me with the corresponding materials for making potions, I can consider cooperating with you."
Merry's bargaining proves that she has gradually matured in the Black Magic Academy.
Facing the cooperation conditions proposed by Meili, Fatty Baos looked bitter at first.
However, after learning from Meili what raw materials she probably needed for the medicine, Fatty's expression became obviously relieved.
"The materials you mentioned are all very low-end and can't use a few black gold, but you must use a lot of them."
"So the specific potionWe have to talk about the after-sales share. "Fat Boss said.
